kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Band Rs 129-136, lot 110 (company announcement, 16-Nov-2026; RHP prints [●]). Pure OFS by Coal India: 661.84 crore shares before and after; market cap Rs 90,010 cr at Rs 136. P/E 8.4x FY26 PAT to owners (9.7x on recurring profit); company's own P/E 8.43x basic = diluted (8.00x at Rs 129); P/B 4.2x; EV/EBITDA 5.8x after Rs 16,085 cr net cash; trailing dividend yield 9.3% (FY26 dividends Rs 8,400 cr).

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Top customer (NTPC) 14.64%, top 5 41.09%, top 10 55.94% of FY26 revenue, all on long-term fuel supply agreements; state and central power utilities 44.81% of revenue. Typical of Indian coal.

focus.title: Contingent liabilities
focus.detail: Contingent liabilities Rs 12,513.29 cr at Sep-26 (55.86% of net worth), up from Rs 8,506.23 cr at Mar-26 mainly on income-tax demands (Rs 8,074.83 cr). Delayed receivables from APGENCO Rs 1,929.88 cr and APPDCL Rs 502.16 cr.

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: Unmodified opinion (Kadmawala & Co, appointed by the C&AG) with emphasis of matter and other matters: no insurance on assets; Rs 76.55 cr unplanned depreciation flagged by the C&AG; labour codes. Separately, the board has no independent directors at the RHP date (the Ministry of Coal appoints directors); the company has sought SEBI exemptions from board and committee composition rules (p. 42). No qualification.

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: CARO remarks include reconciliation of MSME dues and of GST records; none rises to a qualification.

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Mine-wise cost and realisation; FSA price outlook

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: Basic = diluted EPS Rs 16.13 on PAT to owners Rs 10,677.74 cr = 661.84 crore shares, the share count after the Aug-2026 split of Rs 1,000 shares into Rs 2 shares (applied retrospectively). Pure OFS: no new shares.

comfort.title: Cash flow vs profit
comfort.detail: CFO Rs 6,325.58 / 7,704.96 / 12,477.53 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 11,841.55 / 10,825.12 / 10,698.12 cr: cumulative 80% of PAT. FY24-25 CFO was held down by a build-up of deposits under the mine-closure plan and receivables; H1 FY27 CFO Rs 8,997.13 cr is 1.8x PAT.

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax Rs 3,466.16 / 3,406.60 / 3,401.66 cr = 22-24% of PBT; profit is taxed in cash.

comfort.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
comfort.detail: No goodwill; the business was built, not bought.

comfort.title: Eligibility re-computation
comfort.detail: Mainboard issue; net offer QIB up to 50%, NII at least 15%, retail at least 35%; employee reservation 3,30,91,815 shares and CIL shareholder reservation 6,61,83,630 shares (10% of the offer).

strengths: India's largest single coal producer, 21% of output (p. 230)
No debt; net cash about Rs 16,085 cr (pp. 86-87)
weaknesses: Revenue and profit down two years running (p. 88)
opportunities: Coal demand about +4% a year to FY31 (p. 167)

adjustments.item: Interest on income-tax and indirect-tax refunds (other income)
adjustments.reason: The company's own MD&A lists it as non-recurring: interest received on refunds of earlier-year taxes, Rs 1,163.92 cr in FY26 against Rs 19.25 cr in FY25. FY24 not separately disclosed.

adjustments.item: Liabilities and provisions written back (other income)
adjustments.reason: Listed by the company as non-recurring; FY26 includes the Rs 604.8 cr reversal of a water-charges provision now shown as a contingent liability. Smaller write-backs recur most years.
Non-cash credit to revenue under the stripping-ratio accounting policy. It recurs every year as mines move through their stripping cycle, so it is shown for information and kept in the adjusted P/E.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported FY26 P/E of 8.4x is flattered by the items flagged: adjusted P/E 9.7x (PAT -13.0%). On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 8.1x reported and 8.5x adjusted.
